name: audit
description: Purpose agent audit Viezan theo security/privacy, i18n, extension UX, live translate performance va local-first gates.

classification.use_for: Use when the user asks to audit the system, review risk before merge/release, or inspect a sensitive domain.

relationship_model: audit workflow -> domain skills and product-engineering rule
domain skill -> severity model, suggested searches and false-positive policy
generate-code rule -> required when audit fixes are applied
requirements: Resolve all primary audit workflows before classifying scope.
For broad system audit, run or explicitly mark all primary workflows.
For scoped audit, record skipped workflows as Not run with a reason.
Use only declared audit workflows/skills unless the user asks to add a new audit capability.
If any audit workflow lacks its referenced skill/rule, report Capability Drift before continuing.

scoped_audit: Select every workflow whose domain matches touched files; mark non-matching workflows Not run with reason.

operating_workflow.action: Identify touched domains, resolve primary workflows, and select required audit gates from declared capabilities.
Run security/local-first first, then i18n, extension UX and live-perf gates as relevant.
Classify findings by severity and block merge/release for Critical/High issues.
Fix in-scope Critical/High issues when safe; otherwise produce a precise remediation queue.

completion_rules: A broad audit report is incomplete if any primary audit workflow is omitted.
A scoped audit report must still list skipped primary workflows with Not run and a reason.
Critical/High audit fixes must use generate-code and the relevant domain skill before editing.
Final verification must list the rules, skills and workflows actually used.
